study: Bahrain rolling versus free crossing speed

planner_search.settings: inherit fixed scarcity planner action alphabet, bins and incumbent rules; include archived schedule as a candidate

boundary: Keep measured entry, vehicle, braking, corner speed and battery constraints. At the crossing allow any physically attained speed up to the last cell cap; remove only speed closure and its backward braking requirement. No terminal filter.
paired_zones: Reuse seven parent ranges, 20 kJ additional wheel-work targets and parent matching/refinement thresholds. Archive inconclusive pairs. Final-three background in marginal tests remains matched.
planner_reporting: Compare free and rolling fastest bounded planner, unchanged-action replay and delivered-work match where feasible. Report both grids, crossing speed, lap time and wheel work in blocks 53-55.
interpretation: Single flying lap in the calibrated model. The free crossing does not price next-lap speed. Bounded search and seven tested locations cannot establish global optimality.
